summary: Clarify that client diagnostics observations have a 7-day local retention window while server retry/deduplication receipts remain for 30 days; neither retention window nor runtime behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention-rule or TTL change: diagnostics observations keep their existing 7-day local retention window, and server retry/deduplication receipts keep their existing 30-day window.

compatibility.detail: Documentation clarification only; client and server behavior, permissions and wire contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart or coordinated deployment required.

recovery.detail: No rollback or roll-forward action required.
